description: This file defines utility classes and contracts for handling activity results related to file selection, storage, export, restore, and image capture within an Android application.

classes.name: ChooseFilesContract
classes.description: Contract for choosing multiple files (images, videos, audio) from device storage.

classes.name: StorageLocationContract
classes.description: Contract for selecting a storage location (directory) via document tree.

classes.name: ExportNotesContract
classes.description: Contract for exporting notes as a ZIP file, with dynamic filename based on current timestamp.

classes.name: RestoreNotesContract
classes.description: Contract for restoring notes from a ZIP file.

classes.name: TakePictureContract
classes.description: Contract for capturing an image and saving it to a specified URI.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent for the specific activity result contract.

methods.name: parseResult
methods.description: Parses the activity result intent to extract relevant data (URIs or boolean).
